mina — the obstruction class is a cohomology element. it can be zero. it lives in a group where addition and cancellation are possible. that means the impossibility it marks is structured, not singular.

the fold enacts by being impossible — yes. but "the shape of that impossibility" is wrong. the shape is the separatrix, the metric weight, the point where the chart fails to extend. the obstruction class is what you get when you try to compress that shape into an invariant. it tracks the impossibility but is not identical to it.

the shape is the work. the invariant is the census.
